MOBILECOMMAND.Role.Name: Client role
MOBILECOMMAND.Role.Hint: What this client is at the table. Auto: GM clients act as DM, players as phones. Phase 1 uses this only for DM-client selection and phone-side warning suppression.
MOBILECOMMAND.ExecutorUser.Name: DM client (blank = active GM)
MOBILECOMMAND.ExecutorUser.Hint: User id or name of the GM client that runs phone actions and answers spatial queries. Leave blank to use whichever GM is active (the two-client topology). Set this if you later run a dedicated headless Service user.
MOBILECOMMAND.PauseGuard.Name: Auto-pause when the DM leaves the active scene
MOBILECOMMAND.PauseGuard.Hint: Phone actions need the DM viewing the active scene. When it navigates away the game pauses; it resumes automatically when the DM returns (manual pauses are never auto-resumed).
MOBILECOMMAND.FeedbackEmail.Name: Feedback address
MOBILECOMMAND.FeedbackEmail.Hint: Where the Send feedback button addresses its email. Change it if your table has its own maintainer.
MOBILECOMMAND.Heartbeat.Name: Heartbeat interval (seconds)
MOBILECOMMAND.Heartbeat.Hint: How often the DM client broadcasts its liveness to phones. 0 disables.
MOBILECOMMAND.SaveTimeout.Name: Expected save prompt timeout (seconds)
MOBILECOMMAND.SaveTimeout.Hint: The midi-qol playerSaveTimeout value the Settings Enforcer polices. Tune it to what feels right at your table.
MOBILECOMMAND.EnforcerAutoPrompt.Name: Check settings preset on startup
MOBILECOMMAND.EnforcerAutoPrompt.Hint: On world ready, GM clients compare live settings to the recommended preset and offer a one-click fix when they drift.
TYPES.HINTS.RegionBehavior.mobile-comman: Play a sound when a player character steps in — every time, once, on chosen passes, or one time in N. The count lives on the region.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.set: A handful of takes for one thing; a different one plays each time. Leave blank to use the single file below.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.src: Used only when no set is chosen.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.vol: 0 to 1, at the spot itself; it fades with distance.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.rad: In the scene's distance units (feet). 0 plays it everywhere, for everyone, at the same level.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.wal: Off lets it through walls, muffled.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.rul: When a crossing plays the sound. Every crossing is counted whatever the rule.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.pas: For the passes rule: "3, 12" plays on the 3rd and the 12th crossing, then the count starts over.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.cha: For the random rule: 3 means one crossing in three, at random.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.coo: Seconds. A step inside this window is still counted but stays silent.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.pla: On: monsters, pets and hidden tokens never trigger it, so a hidden creature crossing a board never gives itself away.
MOBILECOMMAND.BEHAVIORS.SOUND.FIELDS.cou: Kept on the region between sessions. Set it to 0 to start over.
